profile_text.body:
Richtech Robotics Inc. is listed as a for-profit public company headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada, trading under the ticker RR with CIK 0001963685. The website associated with the company in the data is rolls-royce.com, and the text gathered from that site describes Rolls-Royce rather than Richtech Robotics.

That site text describes Rolls-Royce as a company that pioneers technologies delivering clean, safe and competitive solutions for power needs, and says it has been at the forefront of innovation for more than 100 years. Rolls-Royce describes itself as developing and delivering complex power and propulsion solutions for safety-critical applications in the air, at sea and on land. The site also reports a completed $1 Billion investment in Indiana, which it says cements Indianapolis as one of the most advanced engine manufacturing and test campuses in the world. It notes a strategic intent to partner with Reliance Industries to develop India's indigenous combat engine for the Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA) programme, co-operation with the United Kingdom National Nuclear Laboratory and the Japan Atomic Energy Agency on advanced nuclear technologies, and multiple contractual commitments for Rolls-Royce SMR to deliver SMR units in Europe after signing a contract with CEZ Group.

No litigation cases, products, or MCP servers are listed for the company. Its recorded law exposure is Nevada, with a count of zero.
